Founded in Port Charlotte, Florida, in 2008, and now headquartered in Fort Myers, Millennium Healthcare has quickly become the leading independent physician group with more than 900 healthcare providers across Florida, Georgia, North Carolina, Texas and growing. About Mosaic Health & Millennium Physician Group Mosaic Health is transforming healthcare through an innovative, interconnected value-based care platform that empowers physicians to deliver exceptional outcomes for patients and communities. Millennium Physician Group, a Mosaic Health company, is one of the nation’s leading independent physician groups and a top-performing Accountable Care Organization (ACO), serving hundreds of thousands of patients across multiple states through a physician-led, value-based care model. Shape the Future of Healthcare in Indiana Vice President, Regional Chief Medical Officer Indianapolis, Indiana This isn’t just another executive physician role. It’s an opportunity to build something extraordinary. Millennium Physician Group is expanding into Indiana, and we’re looking for a visionary physician executive to lead the launch of our newest region. As the Vice President, Regional Chief Medical Officer, you won’t inherit the status quo—you’ll help define it. This is a rare opportunity to establish the clinical culture, recruit and inspire physician leaders, drive innovation in value-based care, and create a high-performing medical organization from the ground up. You’ll partner directly with executive leadership to shape the future of care delivery in one of the Midwest’s fastest-growing healthcare markets. If you’ve been waiting for the chance to leave a lasting legacy, this is it. ‎ How Will You Make An Impact & Requirements ‎ Why This Role Matters As the senior physician executive for the Indiana region, you’ll serve as the clinical architect of a new market—bringing together physicians, operational leaders, hospitals, and community partners around a shared vision of exceptional patient care. You’ll influence strategy at the highest level while maintaining what matters most: improving the lives of patients and supporting physicians in delivering outstanding care. What You’ll Lead You’ll have the opportunity to: Launch and lead Millennium’s newest regional physician organization. Develop and execute the clinical strategy that drives growth, quality, and value-based success. Build an engaged, high-performing physician leadership team. Champion clinical excellence, patient safety, and evidence-based care across multiple practice locations. Advance population health initiatives and innovative care delivery models. Partner closely with the Chief Medical Officer, CEO, Market Presidents, and executive leadership to shape regional strategy. Foster strong relationships with hospitals, specialists, employers, and community stakeholders throughout Indiana. Lead physician engagement, succession planning, recruitment, and leadership development. Drive continuous improvement in quality, operational performance, and patient outcomes. Who You Are You’re a respected physician leader who thrives on building organizations, leading change, and bringing people together around a common purpose. You combine clinical credibility with business acumen and understand how to balance physician engagement, operational excellence, and financial stewardship. Most importantly, you’re energized by opportunities where your leadership creates lasting impact. What You’ll Bring MD or DO from an accredited medical school Current unrestricted physician license Board Certification 15+ years of progressive physician leadership experience Executive leadership experience within a physician organization, health system, or integrated delivery network Proven success leading multisite clinical operations, quality improvement, physician engagement, and value-based care Experience driving clinical transformation, population health initiatives, and organizational growth Exceptional communication, strategic thinking, and relationship-building skills Executive Compensation & Benefits We recognize the caliber of leadership this role requires and offer a highly competitive executive compensation package designed to reward both performance and long-term impact. Compensation Includes Base salary: $350,000–$470,000, commensurate with experience and qualifications. This range represents the Company’s good-faith estimate of the compensation it reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, internal equity, and business needs. Annual performance incentive: Eligible for a bonus of up to 40% of base salary Equity opportunity: Participate in the company’s continued growth through an executive equity program Comprehensive executive benefits package, including health, retirement, paid time off, and professional development support Why Indianapolis? Indianapolis offers the perfect combination of professional opportunity and exceptional quality of life. Home to nationally recognized healthcare organizations, world-class sports, vibrant neighborhoods, outstanding schools, and a thriving culinary and arts scene, it’s a city where leaders can build both meaningful careers and fulfilling lives. About Millennium Physician Group Millennium Physician Group, part of the Mosaic Health family, is one of the nation’s leading independent physician groups, dedicated to transforming healthcare through coordinated, patient-centered, value-based care. We believe empowered physicians deliver better outcomes, stronger communities, and healthier futures. Build More Than a Region. Build Your Legacy. If you’re ready to shape the future of healthcare, inspire physicians, and launch a region that will define the next chapter of Millennium Physician Group’s growth, we’d love to meet you. Required Technology Experience Epic EMR experience is required. Candidates must have demonstrated experience utilizing Epic in clinical practice and/or physician leadership roles. As Epic will remain the organization’s primary electronic health record platform for the foreseeable future, candidates without Epic experience will not be considered. Travel & Market Presence This is a field-based leadership position requiring substantial travel throughout the assigned Indiana territory. Candidates must maintain a consistent and visible presence within the market and be comfortable spending significant time visiting physician practices, hospitals, health system partners, and community stakeholders. Preferred home base locations include: South Bend, Indiana Indianapolis, Indiana Candidates residing in Chicago, Illinois or Gary, Indiana may be considered with a demonstrated commitment to extensive in-market travel and engagement.

review_candidates.title: Trade & Customs Associate - Tilburg (38 uur)
review_candidates.description: Job Description To meet our current and future capacity needs, our Trade & Customs team in Tilburg is looking for a new colleague. Tilburg is a key location within H&M Group's logistics network, supporting both retail and online business operations across Europe. We put the customer at the centre of everything we do. Our mission is to ensure products move efficiently through the supply chain and are available when and where our customers need them. To support this mission, we are looking for an ambitious, collaborative, and solution-oriented Trade & Customs Associate to join our team. As a Trade & Customs Associate , you will play an important role in ensuring the smooth import and export operations of goods moving through our distribution centers. You will work closely with transport providers, customs teams, brokers, warehouses, and internal stakeholders to ensure efficient goods flow, regulatory compliance, and high service performance. What will be expected of you? As a Trade & Customs Associate , you will be responsible for coordinating international shipments, supporting customs activities, and ensuring the timely movement of goods across our supply chain. Your key responsibilities will include: Planning and coordinating import flows and cross-docking activities for shipments arriving by sea, air, road, and rail. Monitoring inbound shipments and ensuring timely delivery to the distribution centers in the Netherlands (Tilburg) and other countries. Coordinating customs clearance activities in close cooperation with internal customs teams and external customs brokers. Supporting export processes and cross-border shipments to non-EU destinations in cooperation with internal stakeholders, customs teams, and customs brokers. Preparing, reviewing, and validating commercial invoices, proforma invoices, packing lists, and other customs and financial documentation required for export declarations and international shipment movements. Reviewing and approving transport, freight, and service provider invoices, ensuring accuracy and budget compliance. Communicating daily with transport providers, customs brokers, warehouses, and internal stakeholders to resolve operational issues. Tracking shipments and proactively managing transport disruptions, missing cargo, and delivery exceptions. Supporting transport insurance claims and follow-up activities when required. Maintaining operational reports, statistics, and KPIs to support performance monitoring and continuous improvement. Working closely with warehouse operations teams and 3PL partners to ensure smooth execution of supply chain activities. Contributing to process improvements and helping maintain efficient and compliant logistics operations. Who will you work with? You will collaborate closely with various teams and stakeholders across the H&M Group supply chain, including: Internal Trade & Customs Teams Transport Providers and Freight Forwarders Customs Brokers Warehouse Operations Teams Distribution Centers in Tilburg and other locations Finance Teams Planning and Logistics Teams External Service Providers and 3PL Partners Who are you? We are looking for someone who enjoys working in a international environment and can manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy. You bring: MBO degree and equivalent work experience in logistics, transport operations or international trade. Knowledge of customs procedures, supply chain processes and international trade regulations. Strong communication skills and excellent command of English, both written and spoken. Strong analytical and numerical skills. High attention to detail and an ability to work accurately under pressure. Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel. Experience with SAP or transport management systems is considered an advantage. And as a person, we believe you are: Flexible and willing to support operations in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. Proactive and solution-focused, with the ability to identify issues and resolve them efficiently. Curious and eager to learn and develop within logistics and international trade. Collaborative and capable of building strong relationships across teams and functions. Structured and organized, able to manage multiple tasks simultaneously. Who are we? H&M Group is a global company with strong fashion brands. Our purpose is to prove that great design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions can go hand in hand. We want to make fashion accessible to everyone, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues connected through our shared company culture and values. Together, we use our strengths, skills, and knowledge to make the fashion industry more inclusive and sustainable. What’s in it for you? At H&M Group, we are proud of our energetic and welcoming company culture. We offer attractive benefits and extensive global development opportunities. Competitive salary Staff discount valid across all H&M Group brands, both in-store and online Participation in the H&M Incentive Program (HIP) JOIN US Our unique strength comes from many things: our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and our development opportunities. Above all, it is our people who make us who we are. Does this sound like the next step in your career? Submit your CV in English as soon as possible, and no later than the 3rd of October . Take the next step in your career. Your journey starts here! Due to our data privacy policy, we only accept applications submitted through our career site. We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competencies. Therefore, we kindly ask you not to include a cover letter with your application.

review_candidates.description: Company Description Combined Military Hospitals (CMH) are a network of Pakistan Armed Forces hospitals located across major cantonments in Pakistan. CMH facilities provide comprehensive medical and surgical care to military personnel, their families, and eligible civilians. The hospital system is known for its disciplined environment, structured clinical protocols, and strong emphasis on patient safety. CMH Lahore offers exposure to a wide range of surgical specialties and the opportunity to work within a collaborative, multidisciplinary care team. Professionals joining CMH benefit from a mission-driven setting that supports continuous learning and professional development. Role Description This full-time, on-site Surgical Technologist role is based at CMH Lahore. The Surgical Technologist will prepare operating rooms, ensure all instruments and supplies are sterilized and ready, and assist the surgical team before, during, and after procedures. Daily responsibilities include setting up surgical equipment, maintaining aseptic technique, passing instruments and supplies, handling specimens, and supporting surgeons and anesthetists during operations. The role also involves monitoring and replenishing surgical inventories, adhering to infection control protocols, and accurately documenting relevant surgical activities. The Surgical Technologist will work closely with surgeons, nurses, and other healthcare professionals to deliver safe, efficient, and patient-centered surgical care. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong skills in Surgical Technology, including sterile technique and instrument handling. Candidates should possess experience working in the Operating Room environment and familiarity with standard operating procedures. Candidates should possess capabilities in Surgical Assisting, including supporting surgeons during various types of procedures. Candidates should possess foundational knowledge of Medicine and Surgery relevant to perioperative care. Diploma or degree in Surgical Technology or an equivalent allied health program from a recognized institution. Previous clinical experience in a surgical or perioperative setting, preferably in a hospital environment. Strong attention to detail, adherence to safety and infection control standards, and the ability to work effectively in high-pressure situations. Effective communication skills, teamwork orientation, and willingness to work flexible hours as required by surgical schedules.

review_candidates.title: Registered Midwife
review_candidates.location: Al Ain, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
review_candidates.description: Practice in accordance to the regulator Scope of Practice, ensuring completion of all competencies and required clinical privileging prior to providing direct patient care. Registered Midwives can provide care to the woman and newborn in different practice settings. Provide safe and compassionate care during the antenatal, intrapartum, postnatal, and newborn periods. Provide safe and EBP care in relation to spontaneous vaginal deliveries (SVD), assist with instrumental vaginal deliveries, and caesarean deliveries (both emergent and elective) for the mother and newborn, reflective of scope of practice, life support provider status and clinical privileging. Assist the obstetrician with required procedures or perform as per scope of practice, competence, and clinical privileging, such as artificial rupture of membranes (AROM), sterile vaginal examinations. Monitor the progress of labouring mothers, performs CTG monitoring and interprets findings of foetal heart rates and recognises when to escalate to the obstetrician, reflective of scope of practice, competence, and clinical privileging. Support women during childbirth, reflective of the woman’s birthing plan, is knowledgeable regarding stem cell collection and monitoring in all stages of labour and monitoring the condition of the fetus, reflective of EBP and the WHO Mother Baby Friendly Hospital Initiative. Perform immediate post-delivery care of the mother to include (but not limited to) fundal massage, placental examination, quantifiable blood loss assessment and monitoring of vital signs, with immediate recognition and escalation to the obstetrician as needed, in accordance to scope of practice. Perform immediate post-delivery care of the newborn(s) to include (but not limited to) taking of cord blood gases, performing the initial steps of newborn care, newborn identification, physical assessment and monitoring of vital signs, with immediate recognition and escalation to the neonatologist as needed, in accordance to scope of practice. Support, promote, and protect the ten steps within the WHO Mother Baby Friendly Hospital Initiative recommendations during the antenatal, intrapartum, postnatal, and newborn periods. Provide education and support strategies to the mother and newborn that encourage early breastfeeding, and skin-to-skin bonding. Be responsible for providing and coordinating patient care, educating patients and the public about various health conditions, and providing advice and emotional support to patients and their family members. Assess and identify patients' needs and implement and monitor the patient's medical plan and treatment. They will work with a team of physicians and other health care specialists or allied health in various settings. Perform systematic patient assessment, re-assessment and collect pertinent data about the patient’s health or situation and escalate immediately when appropriate. Understand and analyse the assessment information and data. Determine actual and potential midwifery diagnoses, problems, and issues. Define the predicted and expected outcomes of the patient’s planned care. Create and evaluate patient care plans with the interprofessional team, in collaboration with the patient and patient's bystanders. Record vital signs, recognize, address and escalate all abnormalities or deviations as per policy. Maintain and update technical and clinical skills related to midwifery practice. Employ strategies to promote patients’ health and a safe environment. Understand different diagnostic tests and laboratory examinations. Maintain essential life support as per regulatory requirements and scope of practice such as but not limited to Basic Life Support, PROMPT, CTG and Neonatal Resuscitation. In depth knowledge and clinical skills of Obstetric emergencies, midwifery management of such emergencies and care. Prepare patients for medical examination and treatment. Administer medications and monitor patients closely for any side effects and reactions, for example during an induction of labour. Administer treatments such as IV fluids, IV medications and blood products, monitoring patients for any reactions. Reflective of EBP and when clinically indicated only, perform episiotomy, as per scope of practice, competence, and clinical privileging. Repair perineal laceration first and second degree as per scope of practice, competence, and clinical privileging. Provide wound care management, education and support to women following caesarean sections, episiotomy, and vaginal tears. Assist in medical procedures invasive and non-invasive as needed for the patient and to obtain specimens as ordered. Facilitate the process of safe patient`s admission, transfer and discharge, inclusive of the mother and newborn. Provides parents with bereavement support, advice and compassion during end-of-life care in relation to congenital birth defects, loss of pregnancy, miscarriage, stillbirth and neonatal death. Complies with regulatory and NMC policy requirements with the disposal of human tissue. Qualifications Essential: the post holder must Have an appropriate license to work as a registered nurse in the relevant regulatory health authority with all the qualifications and experience these mandates. Manage their own professional re-licensure. Hold a valid American Heart Association Basic Life Support Provider card. Be willing to work across departments when necessary. Be able to communicate clearly and effectively in English (spoken and written)
